official name of this town is 'Kars

strings.en:
{1c:14}There was just one time those monsters
came up above ground.{1a}34 years before you lot came to this
town... half a year after the 'Demon
December', when monsters first
appeared in Asla Fael.{1a}They came down the Kars mountains and
hit the towns and villages at the foot,
one after another. I still remember the
whole continent going into a panic.{1a}Well, that was long before you were
born, so you wouldn't know about it,{1a}but folks your grandpa and grandma's
age sure would.{1a}In Baileste and Asroit alike, the nobles'
armies were no use at all, just one rout
after another,{1a}the highways were jammed with nobles
and farmers running for their lives, and
in the big cities it got so bad folks even
killed themselves in the panic...{1a}...Now, telling it like that makes it sound
big, but the truth is only about a
hundred monsters came down the
mountains,{1a}and they were small fry at that, the
kind you only see up at the top of the
Black Passage, so they say. As a funny
story, it's a sorry one.{1a}Anyway, the walls around this town ain't
here to protect us.{1a}Those walls are there so not one
monster gets out, to keep the damage
as small as it can be.{1a}If monsters far stronger than those
ever came up above ground in a great
horde,{1a}the gates of this town would never,
ever open. Meaning we'd be left to die so
folks outside stay safe.{1a}That's why they call this town the
'Coffin of Kars' too.{1a}Mind you, it ain't nothing to lose sleep
over.{1a}Maybe they're scared of sunlight, maybe
they hate the smell of human farts, I
dunno, but monsters ain't shown their
faces above ground once since then.{1a}Now, a disaster that wasn't monsters,
there was one a year and a half before
you came... No, this ain't the time to talk
about that.{0c:040d}

strings.en:
{1c:10}You know this already, but this town's
ruled jointly by the Kingdom of Asroit
and the Republic of Baileste.{1a}Not that the bigwigs of the two great
powers care about the secrets of an
ancient civilization or why monsters
showed up, seems like.{1a}They only care about the treasure we
bring back, and that prize they say gives
eternal life, the 'Azare Stone'.{1a}This town used to have a 'Governor's
Office', and they'd search your
belongings every time you went in or out
of the ruins,{1a}but about 20 years back the officials all
ran off, and ever since then the place
has been in total anarchy.{1a}Well, with those nobles gone, all high and
mighty and no real ability to back it up,{1a}we've been able to take things easy, I'll
say that.{1a}Course, they may have run off, but
they'd never let go of this money tree.{1a}There's only two routes to get treasure
out of this town: use a device called a
'Transporter', or go down that steep
mountain road you came up yourselves.{1a}These days, instead of keeping a
Governor's Office, they hold those two
routes, and that gives 'em a full grip on
every treasure found here.{1a}That way, more than half the treasure
we find here ends up in the nobles'
pockets.{1a}Well, it burns me up, but there's no
helping it. That's how the world goes.{0c:040d}

strings.en:
{1c:13}Whatever country you're from, noble or
thief, in this town everyone's just an
adventurer.{1a}There's no police or army here to keep
order, and no laws or station to tie us
down. In other words, this place is a
total 'lawless zone'.{1a}Plenty of wanted men have fled to this
town, in fact, and there's no shortage
of dangerous fellas who don't give a
fart for a human life.{1a}All you can rely on is your own skill... In
this town, 'strength' is justice. The
strong can do whatever they want,
'cause there's nobody to arrest 'em.{1a}Ain't the prettiest comparison, but it's
like a troop of monkeys on a hill.{1a}Used to be, more folks died in fights and
lynchings between adventurers than got
killed by monsters in the ruins.{1a}Any other adventurer was your enemy in
the scramble for richer treasure,
somebody to outfox and knock down,
taking his life if need be...{1a}...That said, as luck would have it, things
ain't as ugly now as they used to be.{1a}Right now, the strongest man in this
town, the boss monkey, is Valdes.{1a}He hates anything crooked, and he don't
push his ideas or his ways on others, so
this town today is heaven compared to
the old days.{1a}Thanks to him, there's less pointless
killing, and a funny sort of fellowship has
grown up among adventurers.{1a}...Still, don't forget that underneath, it
ain't changed all that much.{1a}Could be it's only working out because
Valdes happens to be that kind of man.
If you want to survive, get strong!{0c:040d}

strings.en:
{1c:10}You're interested in an old wreck like

Fisano, met Emilia, my wife, my ex-wife

late as it was, had my first child.{1a}At 38, came to this town to grow my
business. At 42, my wife and child ran
out on me.{1a}At 43, I figured spending the rest of my
life here might not be so bad,{1a}so I sold off the trading houses I kept in
Baileste and went free merchant, and
that same year I met Valdes.{1a}At 50, Sadiya and Fatum and Tiara-chan
turned up. At 52, Qumran turned up,{1a}and at 58, you lot turned up...{1a}Funny how much you remember. Surprised

strange thing, it really is.{1a}Fellas who'd have been dead long ago if
not for him: 20, at the lowest count,{1a}and you lot'll be joining that count soon,
by my reckoning.{1a}And fellas whose way of thinking he
might've changed: 15, at the lowest
count, and the real number's probably
several times that.{1a}I agonized about coming to this town too.
24 years a man of the sea, could I stand
life on land, what if a monster ate me,
that sort of thing.{1a}If not for the friend and the wife who
gave me a push then, I'd never have met
you lot or Valdes.{1a}Go back further, and if my old man
hadn't run off with a woman, I'd never
have gone to sea. I'd have taken over his
plastering trade.{1a}And I'd never have come to this town,
naturally. It's because my old man had a
mistress that I got to meet you lot.{1a}The way people meet is a strange thing,
it really is. Even at my age, it's one
surprise after another.{1a}In this big wide world, maybe it's because
you went and met someone that you
oughta take good care of 'em.{1a}Thanks. And don't die.{0c:040d}
